note: Designer ruling 2026-08-23. The death sheet teaches 'unlock Auto-Eat' on the player's first death; Auto-Eat cost 100 Bounty Marks (~18 contracts, ~1800 kills), so the lesson named a purchase the first week could not make. Adds a 15-Mark entry tier triggering at 25% HP; the existing 100-Mark trait becomes tier II with today's settable threshold. Server-side a tier is a CEILING on player_state.auto_eat_pct (tier 1 -> 25, tier 2 -> 100), read from the kind='flag' unlock rows trait:auto_eat / trait:auto_eat_2. Adds hr_auto_eat_tier + hr_auto_eat_max_pct (neither client-reachable) and RESTATES hr_set_auto_eat to (i) gate 'enable' on owning ANY tier rather than one trait id and (ii) clamp v_pct to the ceiling AFTER the coalesce(p_pct, stored), so the null-pct path is clamped too. The clamp is on the WRITE path only, and the header derives why that is sufficient — hr_set_auto_eat is the single writer of both auto_eat_pct and auto_eat_enabled (GATE(e) re-proves it by scanning every SQL/plpgsql body in public), the engine only eats when enabled, and entitlements are monotone. That is what keeps hr_state_of — the most-restated body in the schema, with a generated derivation chain — out of this change. Must run AFTER 2026-08-15-auto-eat.sql (restates its function) and AFTER the regenerated 2026-08-16-unlocks.generated.sql (its precondition asserts the trait:auto_eat_2 catalogue row). Touches no graded body -> on no derivation chain. hr_set_auto_eat keeps its authenticated grant + its existing hr_client_rpc_baseline row (identity_args unchanged). NO edge redeploy: src/core/auto-eat.js IS in the hr-accrue bundle, but the tier helpers added to it are client-only readers — the engine's inputs (autoEatEnabled/autoEatPct) are unchanged and resolveAutoEat is untouched, so the deployed payload's BEHAVIOUR does not move. Reversibility: re-apply 2026-08-15-auto-eat.sql §2.
